entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I'm calling about the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor I bought. I'm just so disappointed with it.
I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with it. To best help you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not broken, I don't think. It's just so confusing. I've read the user manual multiple times, but I still find it really hard to use. Honestly, I just expected more from it. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time and I saved up for this... I feel a bit silly, and I really could use that money back.

I understand completely. It's important that you're happy with your purchase. Let me pull up your account and our return guidelines. I see you received the VeloBand Pulse 29 days ago. One moment while I check the policy.
Okay, thank you. I really hope you can help.
Alright, I've got it here. It looks like our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the timeframe.
Oh, really? So I... I can send it back for a refund?

Yes, absolutely. I can go ahead and authorize that return for you right now. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to your email on file. Just place the VeloBand back in its original packaging and use that label to send it back to us for a full refund.
Wow. That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Alex. You have no idea how much this helps me.
You're very welcome. I'm happy I could get this sorted out for you. Will there be anything else today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for being so understanding.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
